data.name: Camala
data.gender_notes: Camala is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'kamelos', meaning 'young', and 'ala', meaning 'shepherdess'. This name was given to girls in ancient Greece who worked as shepherds. The name Camala carries the meaning “Young shepherdess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Camala usually hope their child will grow to embody young shepherdess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing innocence, nurturing, and dedication to nature and care for others.
data.etymology: Camala belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young shepherdess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Camala total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: קַמַלָא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עץ שגדל על קיר הוא תיאור של קמלא, עץ שגדל על קיר, המופיע במקרא. השם קמלא קשור לסמלי הברית החדשה, שם אלוהים, שם האב, שם אסתר, ושם הקדוש. קמלא גם מסמל את האהבה והקדושה. במסורת היהודית, קמלא נזכר כסמל לאהבה והשגחה אלוהית. השם קמלא נמצא בספרות יהודית ונוצרית, ונחשב לשם קדוש. קמלא קשור גם לביטוי 'קמלא' המשמע עץ שגדל על קיר.

in_greek.name: Καμάλα

Στην Παλαιά Διαθήκη, ο Καμάλα είναι ο όρος που χρησιμοποιείται για την περιποίηση και την φροντίδα του Δαβίδ από τον Σολομώνα. Στην Βιβλική αστρολογία, ο Καμάλα είναι ο όρος που χρησιμοποιείται για την προστασία και την προστασία από τις αρρώστιες και τις αρρώστιες. Στην Βυζαντινή Αυτοκρατορία, ο Καμάλα ήταν ο τίτλος που δινόταν στον Αυτοκράτορα από την Εκκλησία.

in_latin.name: Camala
in_latin.long_meaning: Camala est nomen quod significat defensio et protegtere. In Veteri Testamento, Camala est nomen quod significat custodia et protegtere. In astrologia biblica, Camala est nomen quod significat protegtere a morbis et a malis. In Imperio Byzantino, Camala erat titulus qui dabantur Imperatori a Ecclesia.

in_english.name: Camala
in_english.long_meaning: Camala is a name that means defend and protect. In the Bible, Camala is a name that means custody and protection. In biblical astrology, Camala is a name that means protect from diseases and evils. In Christian tradition, Camala is associated with the name of God, the name of the Father, the name of Esther, and the name of the Saint. Camala also symbolizes love and holiness. In Jewish tradition, Camala is mentioned as a symbol of God's love and providence. The name Camala is found in Jewish and Christian literature and is considered a sacred name. Camala is also related to the term 'Camala' meaning a tree that grows on a wall.
